basic_details.job_title: IIT Delhi Senior Project Assistant (Computer Science & Engineering) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: One Sr.Project Assistant (Tech) post is open in the Department of Computer Science & Engineering, Indian Institute of Technology Delhi (Industrial Research & Development Unit), under the project "Developing Digital Public Infrastructure for Social Good" (RP04961N), funded by Tower Research Capital Markets India Private Limited and Asankhya Trading Private Limited. The appointment is contractual with a consolidated pay of Rs. 47,790 to Rs. 62,350 per month plus HRA @ 30%, renewable yearly or up to the project's duration (upto 28/01/2030), whichever is earlier. Eligible candidates hold a B. Tech

how_to_apply: Download Form No. IRD/REC-4 from the IRD website of IIT Delhi (http://ird.iitd.ac.in/rec).
Fill in the form with complete information regarding educational qualifications, indicating percentage of marks/division.
Add the details of work experience in the form.
Email the duly filled form to Prof. Aaditeshwar Seth at [email protected].
Write the advertisement number (IITD/IRD/329/2026) on the subject line of the email.
Send it before 14 December 2026, 5.00 p.m., the last date for submitting completed applications by e-mail.
For any clarification on eligibility for this post, candidates may contact Prof. Aaditeshwar Seth at [email protected].

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice prints the following for the Sr.Project Assistant (Tech) post: Essential: B. Tech. / B.E. / AMIE and equivalent OR Technical Diploma (3 years duration) / Graduate Degree in appropriate discipline with 5 years relevant work experience. Exceptional cases: ITI (2 years duration) with 11 years of work experience in relevant field may also be considered. Desirable: Good knowledge of AI fundamentals. Desirable: 2 (or more) year(s) of experience in research work in the field of AI. Nationality: Applications are invited from Indian nationals. Relaxation: 5% relaxation of marks may be granted to the SC/ST candidates. The notice does not mention an age limit for this post. Candidates should check the official notification for the exact discipline-specific eligibility for the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The consolidated fellowship / pay-slab printed for the Sr.Project Assistant (Tech) is Rs. 47,790 - 49,220 - 50,700 - 52,220 - 53,790 - 55,400 - 57,060 - 58,770 - 60,530 - 62,350/- p.m. plus HRA @ 30%. The appointment is on a contractual basis with consolidated pay. It is renewable yearly or upto the duration of the project, whichever is earlier; the project runs upto 28/01/2030. If a retired/superannuated government employee is selected, his/her salary will be fixed as per prevailing IRD norms.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Delhi Sr.Project Assistant (Tech)
content_sections.text: For any clarification on eligibility for this post, candidates may contact Prof. Aaditeshwar Seth at [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: IIT Delhi reserves the right to fix higher criteria for short-listing eligible candidates from those satisfying the advertised qualification and requirement of the project post. Names of short-listed candidates will be displayed on the web link http://ird.iitd.ac.in/shortlisted along with the online interview details. Only short-listed candidates will be informed for the online interview.

faq.answer: Download Form No. IRD/REC-4 from http://ird.iitd.ac.in/rec, fill it with qualification (percentage of marks/division) and work experience details, and email it to [email protected].

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the IIT Delhi Sr.Project Assistant (Tech) post?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates are short-listed, and only short-listed candidates are informed for an online interview; their names appear on http://ird.iitd.ac.in/shortlisted.
